evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Ratification language performs the settling of a contract; the act itself is decision-grade.

evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt.

observations.why: Operational invariants stated as absolute rules ('No blocking call', 'no lost work') — bedrock constraints the speaker treats as constitutive of the contract.

evidence.quote:
remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: Plain unhedged assertion of how the mechanism works — asserted and ready to defend, but describing behavior rather than performing a settlement.
